name: succinate dehydrogenase complex subunit D
pathways: mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone

function.text: SDHD encodes succinate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] cytochrome b small subunit, mitochondrial. Annotated molecular activities include electron transfer activity and heme binding. It participates in tricarboxylic acid cycle and mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma (autosomal dominant); pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; SDH-deficient renal cell carcinoma; Succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient gastrointestinal stromal tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
